features.name: Duncan Garden
features.description: Duncan Garden is Manito Park's three-acre formal European Renaissance-style garden, with geometric annual beds, manicured turf, paths, and Davenport Fountain.
features.source_label: City of Spokane Parks and Recreation

features.name: Nishinomiya-Tsutakawa Japanese Gardens
features.description: Nishinomiya-Tsutakawa Japanese Garden is Manito Park's enclosed sister-city garden, with a koi pond, bridges, stonework, carefully maintained plantings, and quiet walking paths.
features.source_label: City of Spokane Parks and Recreation
